text: The Sealion Zero Six EV offers six hundred and five kilometres of CLTC range.
A seventy-eight point seven two kilowatt-hour Blade battery powers the journey.
Zero to one hundred kilometres per hour in seven point seven seconds.
DC charging from thirty to eighty percent takes about eighteen minutes,
under suitable battery and charging conditions.
DiPilot One Hundred combines three-camera vision with highway and parking assistance.
Features depend on configuration and market. Driver supervision is required.
A two-thousand-eight-hundred-and-twenty-millimetre wheelbase creates space for five.
Adjustable suspension supports everyday ride comfort.
Front, side, curtain and centre airbags provide occupant protection.
Electronic stability control and tyre pressure monitoring add everyday reassurance.
